jobs.occupation: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**About Us

**You know that rental bike you unlocked with your phone this morning? Or the tracker on your dog's collar that tells you he's two streets away, again? Neither of those works without a network connection. Onomondo is the layer that makes sure the data actually gets through.

We're the infrastructure behind the Internet of Things (IoT). Companies building connected products come to us for the connectivity that keeps their devices online, anywhere in the world, and for the platform where they manage, monitor, and troubleshoot it themselves.

****Where we sit

****We're somewhere between SaaS and telecom. We sell software, so we move fast, ship often, and care about the user experience. But we also operate inside telecommunications: which is more complex and technical than most software. Our customers are engineers, they ask hard questions and the relationship starts rather than ends at purchase.

That mix also makes us sticky. Most SaaS tools are nice to have. If our connectivity stops, our customers' products stop. That means our business grows as our customers and the industry grows. We've been growing fast and we don't plan to slow down, which is exactly why we need this role.

****Why this role exists

****At Onomondo, connectivity isn’t a commodity. It’s infrastructure. And our Account Managers are the ones who ensure our most important customers treat it that way.

We’re looking for a strategic Account Manager to own the post-signature commercial lifecycle of Onomondo’s largest and most complex accounts. This role sits at the intersection of commercial strategy, relationship ownership, and value delivery — with clear accountability for Gross Revenue Retention (GRR), renewal management, and account expansion including Net New MRR.

You’ll be expected to drive growth within existing accounts by proving value, navigating stakeholders, and designing expansion paths that turn early success into long-term reliance on Onomondo’s full-stack connectivity platform.

****What You’ll Be Doing

• Own the commercial relationship for a portfolio of Onomondo's largest, most complex accounts, as the main contact for decision-makers and budget holders. CS stays the technical and operational contact.

• Run renewals and negotiations, including contracts, pricing adjustments and commitment pacing, so revenue stays predictable and GRR is protected.

• Spot churn risk early and act on it, working with Finance, Legal and RevOps on SLAs, contract updates and billing.

• Find and build expansion: map stakeholders, uncover new business units, geographies and use cases, and turn them into pipeline and Net New MRR. Mutual Success Plans covering 12 to 24 months are part of this.

• Prove value every quarter through Impact Reviews that use data, benchmarks and real results to tie Onomondo to customer outcomes.

• Coordinate across teams and keep the data clean: align with CS, AEs, Product and RevOps, own commercial escalations, keep forecasts and renewal stages accurate, and keep the Ideal Expansion Profile up to date.

****What we're looking for

• Proven experience of 3 years+ managing strategic accounts in a B2B SaaS, telco, or connectivity context

• Demonstrated success owning a book of business with revenue responsibility (GRR, NRR)

• Ability to navigate complex stakeholder ecosystems and build C-level trust

• Strong commercial acumen — negotiation, forecasting, pricing, value-based selling

• Experience running QBRs, success planning, or account mapping at scale

• Knowledge of HubSpot, Tableau, or enterprise CRM/reporting tools

• Comfortable working cross-functionally with CS, Product, and Operations

• Structured thinker with excellent communication and executive presence

****Nice to Have

• Background in IoT, telecom, or infrastructure-as-a-service

• Familiarity with frameworks like SPICED or similar customer lifecycle models

• Experience managing multi-country deployments or hardware/software integrated customers

• Exposure to customers in sectors like logistics, manufacturing, or mobility

****Why join Onomondo?

****We’re not building another SIM provider. We’re building the infrastructure layer for the next generation of connected products. If you want to work in a scale-up that feels more like a challenger brand than a telecom — and you believe in clarity, accountability, and momentum — you’ll fit right in.

We're a team of engineers, operators, and commercial minds in Copenhagen who debate passionately about technical or GTM approaches and then go for a run together. Or padel. Or a beer. Or a boardgame night. People here stay curious, speak up when something feels off, and bring energy whether it's a product launch sprint or a Friday bar.

Practically speaking, that looks like: full health insurance, catered cooked-on-site lunch every day, an in-office gym with HIIT and yoga three times a week during work hours (we're serious about this), quarterly Friday bars, an espresso machine, a full snack and drink-bar and a pretty impressive breakfast setup.

****Our hiring process

****We care deeply about creating a fair and inclusive process.

That means:

• We don’t need your picture or cover letter - just your CV

• We select candidates based on skills and relevant work experience for the role.

****What you can expect:

• 30-minutes screening call with Giacomo, Sales & AM Director

• 90-minutes skill interview including business case (in-person) with Jillian (CCO), Giacomo & Cláudia(AM) - this is also an opportunity to meet some of your potential colleagues

• 30-minutes final stage - Meet one of our Co-founders Michael Karlsen

If you have questions, feel free to reach out to Giacomo, Sales & Account Management Director at +4521895512 .

****Ready to Make an Impact?

****Send us your application, and let’s start the conversation.

Note - We review and interview candidates continually, and therefore encourage you to apply at your earliest convenience.

jobs.occupation: Senior ML Data Engineer
jobs.description:
**About GoWish, Ønskeskyen ☁️

**At GoWish, we’re building the world’s leading wish-list and social shopping platform - a place where you can make a real impact and have fun doing it.

We’re on a mission to reinvent gifting for millions. We win together, driven by curiosity, ownership, and bold ideas that turn into real products. We experiment cross-functionally, push for excellence, and keep things playful as we grow - together.

**Team & Role Overview

**We are looking for a systems-minded Senior ML Data Engineer to own the offline-to-online feature infrastructure that powers our real-time recommendation and search engines at scale. You will be building the low-latency data syncs and feature-serving layers that bridge our analytical warehouses with operational databases, caches, and Feature Stores. This is a role for a performance-driven engineer who excels at pipeline orchestration (Airflow, dbt), Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Docker), and database tuning, ensuring our recommendation systems receive reliable data under strict low-latency SLAs. If you thrive on solving complex data synchronization challenges, scaling operational storage for millions of users, and acting as the operational bridge between Data Science and Backend Engineering - you will play a critical role in powering our product's core ML capabilities.

**What You'll Do

**

• Offline-to-Online Feature Pipelines: Build and operate resilient feature pipelines syncing transformed data from analytical warehouses (e.g., BigQuery) into operational storage layers (e.g., AlloyDB, Redis, Feature Stores) to serve real-time ML recommendation models at scale.

• Pipeline Orchestration and Transformations: Design, test, and maintain robust Apache Airflow DAGs and modular dbt transformations to automate end-to-end data ingestion and feature generation under strict low-latency SLAs.

• Infrastructure as Code and Reliability: Provision, scale, and automate cloud data infrastructure using Terraform, Docker, and CI/CD pipelines, implementing automated data quality testing and monitoring across all feature syncs.

• Cross-Functional System Design: Partner directly with Data Scientists and Backend Engineers to define online/offline feature contracts, optimize database schemas for sub-second queries, and eliminate training-serving skew for millions of active users.

**What we’re looking for 🌟

****We Imagine That You Have

**

• 4+ years of experience

• Operational Data Pipelines: Proven experience moving batch features from analytical warehouses (BigQuery, Snowflake) into low-latency online stores (AlloyDB, Redis, Feature Stores) to serve real-time ML recommendation models.

• Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Deep hands-on experience provisioning, scaling, and managing cloud data infrastructure using Terraform, Docker, and modern CI/CD automation pipelines.

• Pipeline Orchestration & Transformations: Strong track record building, scheduling, and maintaining workflow orchestrations (e.g., Airflow, Dagster) and modular data transformation frameworks (e.g., dbt).

• Database Performance Tuning: Advanced SQL skills across both OLAP and OLTP systems. Ability to optimize schemas, indexing, partitioning, and queries.

It is further seen as an advantage to have experience with:

• Production Feature Management: Experience managing Feature Stores (e.g., Feast, Tecton) or low-latency key-value stores (e.g., Redis) to serve online ML features with zero training-serving skew.

• Real-Time OLA): Experience with ClickHouse, Pinot, Druid or others for ultra-fast aggregations over live event streams.

• Event Streaming: Hands-on experience with streaming tools like GCP Pub/Sub, Kafka, or Flink for real-time feature updates.

Why GoWish should sit at top of your career wish list 💙

At GoWish, we believe great work comes from people who feel energized, supported, and excited to show up every day. That’s why we’ve built a workplace where celebration, growth, and genuine enjoyment are part of the journey - not perks on the side.

Take your birthday off with Happy Birthday Leave, enjoy 30 days of vacation to fully recharge, and join a team that fills the year with events and playful happenings. We invest in your future with pension and insurance, fuel your days with a weekly lunch scheme, and keep you going with unlimited snacks and sodas - because work should feel good.

At GoWish, you don’t just build great products. You build a great work life.

**Practical information

**We collaborate in a flexible hybrid setup, with most of our magic happening at our bright, modern office in Østerbro - perfectly placed between Nordhavn and Østerport Station. We’re ready for you to join us as soon as you are.

👉 Ready to help shape a platform that already empowers 18+ million users (and counting)? Join us at GoWish - and let’s build the future of data-driven innovation together.

Don’t wait to apply - we review applications continuously and may close the position once the right candidate is found.

jobs.occupation: Build your career in Transfer Pricing - Copenhagen
jobs.description:
Company Description

With more than 3000 employees Deloitte is the largest audit and consultancy firm in Denmark. We tailor solutions across Audit, Tax, Financial Advisory Services, Enterprise Risk Services, and Consulting.

About the team

Join our Transfer Pricing team of more than 45 colleagues in Copenhagen and Aarhus. We help international and Danish businesses turn complex tax, finance and operating-model questions into practical solutions. You will build your expertise through real client work, structured learning and close collaboration and help clients navigate tax and transfer pricing challenges.

Job Description

You will work on a wide range of transfer pricing projects across various sectors. Together with your colleagues, you will help clients manage operational transfer pricing matters, audits and compliance, and provide both global and local advice. You can expect a steep learning curve, and  responsibilities that grow with your experience - supported by structured onboarding, regular feedback and close collaboration with experienced colleagues. Alongside your client work, you will have opportunities to attend training in Denmark and at Deloitte University in Paris, strengthening both your technical expertise and client-facing skills.

Ready to take the next step in your career? In this role, you will be involved in:

• Collect and analyse financial and business data for transfer pricing projects across sectors.

• Prepare transfer pricing documentation, benchmarking analyses and intercompany agreements.

• Support audits, international tax requirements and country-by-country reporting.

• Turn your analysis into clear client advice, join client meetings and follow up on agreed actions.

• Contribute ideas to proposals, AI-enabled tools and practical improvements to how we work.

We work in a dynamic, international environment with an informal tone, where quality, collaboration and different perspectives are central to how we create value for clients and for each other.

AI-enabled and digital tools are a natural part of how we work. You will learn to use them responsibly to explore data, support research and benchmarking, improve workflows and strengthen deliverables. No prior AI expertise is required - curiosity, sound judgement and a willingness to learn matter most.

We value the community that extends beyond client work. Our employee association brings people together throughout the year - from social events to shared experiences that cut across teams and business units. We celebrate the wins, big and small, and make a point of recognising individual and shared milestones

The role is full-time, and we are looking for professionals for our offices in both Copenhagen and Aarhus, Denmark.

Qualifications

We are looking for Consultants and Senior Consultants with 0–3 years of relevant experience.

We imagine that you are curious, ambitious and motivated by complex challenges. You take ownership of your responsibilities, collaborate openly with colleagues and clients, and contribute to bringing projects to a successful conclusion.

What you bring to the team:

• A relevant academic background, such as law, economics, finance, accounting or business.

• 0–3 years of relevant experience; internships and student roles are also valuable.

• Analytical, conceptual-thinking and problem-solving skills.

• Curiosity about technology and judgement when using AI-enabled tools.

• Clear communication and an interest in turning complexity into practical advice.

• Good energy and a strong client service instinct

Even if you do not see yourself in all the bullets above, we still encourage you to apply if you believe your skills can make an impact on our team.

Additional Information

Do you want to be part of our team?

Click the "I am interested" button above if you are ready to join our team.

Send your CV, grade transcript and application in which you present yourself and elaborate on your motivation for pursuing a career in Transfer Pricing and/or highlight relevant projects or previous experience by 5 November 2026. We regularly call for interviews, so send your application already today.

Please do not hesitate to contact Partner Cecilie Emilie Rendtorff at +45 26 61 53 93 or Aske Haahr Lauridsen at +45 20 41 35 92 if you have any questions about the position.

We encourage all candidates to apply for the position regardless of, e.g., age, gender (gender identity and gender expression), sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, nationality, or disability.

By applying for this job, you will be assessed against the Deloitte Global Talent Standards. We have designed these standards to provide a consistent and exceptional Deloitte employee experience globally.

We look forward to connecting with you!

In Deloitte, you will find passionate, caring people who are curious by nature and striving to evolve. We value our different skills, perspectives and experiences and foster an environment where innovative powers thrive. To us, success is the feeling that the work we are doing will outlast us. The impact we make is not about what we achieve as individuals, but how we enable those around us to be their very best. From professional development to leadership opportunities, we empower our people to be extraordinary by playing to their strengths – because that is how we can make a difference.

jobs.occupation: PhD position at the Center for Polariton-driven Light-Matter Interactions (POLIMA)
jobs.description:
The Center for Polariton-driven Light-Matter Interactions (POLIMA) at The Mads Clausen Institute, University of Southern Denmark, is seeking a talented and highly motivated PhD student to work on the development of new theoretical frameworks for describing light–matter interactions in advanced van der Walls heterostructures probed by polaritons generated through inelastic tunneling. The position is funded by a Villum Young Investigator grant awarded to Assistant Professor P. André D. Gonçalves, who will supervise the PhD research.

The position is available starting 1 March 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

The successful candidate will develop new theoretical frameworks and computational methods to investigate the fundamental limits of polariton-mediated inelastic electron tunneling in tunnel junctions based on van der Waals heterostructures composed of atomically thin materials. The project will employ a broad range of analytical, semi-analytical, and numerical techniques to explore electrically driven polaritonic phenomena. A major focus will be on harnessing polariton-mediated inelastic electron tunneling as a tool to probe and manipulate light–matter interactions at the nanoscale, as well as to characterize the optoelectronic response of complex quantum materials.

We welcome candidates with a strong background in condensed-matter physics and/or quantum nanophotonics who are highly motivated and eager to pursue world-class research in theoretical quantum nano-optoelectronics. Experience with scientific programming is expected, while familiarity with numerical techniques is advantageous but not required. The ideal candidate will be enthusiastic about contributing to cutting-edge research in a dynamic and ambitious young research group, supported by the POLIMA Center and its extensive network of international collaborators.

POLIMA is a Center of Excellence funded by the Danish National Research Foundation (DNRF) for an initial period of 6 years (2023–2028), with the possibility of a 4-year extension. The center is led by Professor N. Asger Mortensen and currently consists of two Professors, three Assistant Professors, a Lab Manager, a Center Administrator, and approximately 10–15 PhD students, postdocs, and visiting scientists. Several POLIMA researchers have attracted prestigious personal grants, e.g., Villum Investigator, Villum Young Investigator, DFF Sapere Aude, Novo Nordisk’s Foundation RECRUIT and Data Science Investigator – Emerging, and Maria Skłodowska-Curie Fellowships. Read more on POLIMA’s website.

We offer a competitive and highly collaborative research environment with close interaction between experimental and theoretical activities. You will join a thriving community of researchers and benefit from a strong network of international collaborators. Our work environment is supportive, dynamic, and designed to foster creativity and the development of innovative projects.

 

We offer:

• A PhD student position in an ambitious and supportive, international research environment.

• A dedicated supervisor research team to support the academic development of the PhD student.

• Access to state-of-the-art equipment, facilities, and infrastructure.

• A competitive salary and social benefits (e.g., health coverage, parental leave, social security, etc.) (https://www.sdu.dk/en/om-sdu/international-staff/getting-settled)

POLIMA is located at the University of Southern Denmark in Odense – 1h15min by train from Copenhagen Airport. The University of Southern Denmark offers dedicated assistance and support with various practical, social, and legal aspects (housing, visa, administration, tax, etc.), especially for international candidates through our international staff office (ISO) and the administrative staff at POLIMA.

 

For further information and details about the position, application, and the research center, please contact Assistant Professor Paulo André Dias Gonçalves (padgo@mci.sdu.dk).

If you experience technical problems, please contact hcm-support@sdu.dk. 

 

Application

Before applying the candidates are advised to read the Faculty information for prospective PhD students and the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and an application must include: 

• 
Motivated application. 

• 
Curriculum Vitae.

• 
Master’s and bachelor’s degree certificates or equivalent, including transcripts of grades (copy of original and an official English translation).  

• 
Completed TEK PhD application form for 5+3 applicants. Find the form at the Faculty website.

• 
Completed TEK PhD form for calculation grade point average. Find the form at the Faculty website. 

• 
An official document describing the grading scheme of the awarding universities (if not Danish). 

• 
Only for applicants from programmes that evaluate thesis/examination project by approved/not approved: An official written assessment of the thesis or dissertation project from the grade giving institution. The statement must clearly state that the candidate has been among the top 30 pct. in the graduation class for the study programme.

• 
List of publications and maximum 2 examples of relevant publications (in case you have any publications).

• 
References may be included, you're welcome to use the form for reference letter at the Faculty website.

• 
A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is 31 December, 2026, at 11:59 PM / 23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU. Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process. 

 

Enrollment and employment terms

Appointment as a PhD fellow is a 3-year salaried position, and the monthly gross salary incl. pension is 37.075 DKK. If you have relevant postgraduate experience, you may be placed on a higher salary step.

The preferred start date is 1 March 2026 (may be adjusted by mutual agreement) or as soon as possible thereafter. 

Applicants must hold a master’s degree (equivalent to a Danish master's degree) at the time of enrollment and employment. Employment is contingent on enrollment approved by the PhD School. Enrollment will be in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order). Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for PhD fellows as described therein as well as the Protocol on PhD fellows signed by the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

-

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

jobs.occupation: Get your graduate degree at a top 100 university
jobs.description:
The Graduate School of Natural Sciences (GSNS) at Aarhus University are looking for a number of bright, enthusiastic and ambitious candidates who are interested in pursuing a PhD education.

We offer several PhD positions in the following programmes:
• Biology
• Chemistry
• Computer Science 
• Geoscience
• Mathematics
• Molecular Biology and Genetics (incl. Molecular Medicine and Bioinformatics)
• Physics and AstronomyThe University is located in Aarhus, Denmark, which provides international students with a safe and stable environment, a high standard of living and a wealth of social opportunities.

Besides having an excellent reputation that enables our PhD graduates to find outstanding employment prospects, Aarhus University offers attractive working conditions, research support and campus resources. Read more about all the benefits and why you should do a PhD at GSNS here.
Applications are accepted from students and graduates with an academic record corresponding to at least one year of a Master’s degree.

The application deadline is 1 November 2026 at midnight 23:59 CET, with a starting date of 1 February 2027 or later.

Read more about the open call and how to apply on our website here.

Terms of enrolment
PhD students at the Graduate School of Natural Sciences at Aarhus University are always enrolled. The enrolment takes place in accordance with the Ministerial PhD Order no. 1039 of 27 August 2013 and the terms stated in the Rules and Regulations at the Graduate School of Natural Sciences. Both can be found here.

If you are enrolled in the 4- or 5-year schemes, and if you are offered an SU PhD Scholarship in connection with the first years of this type of enrolment, the offer will be according to the rules set out in the State Educational Grant and Loan Scheme (in Danish) (SU-loven). In addition, you might be offered to undertake paid work of up to 280 hours during your part A enrolment period.

Terms of employment
If you are offered employment at Aarhus University in connection with enrolment in the 3-year scheme, the appointment is made in accordance with the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Danish Universities as well as the circular on the Collective Agreement for Academics Employed by the State (in Danish).

You can read more about the 3-, 4- and 5-year scheme here.

jobs.occupation: Operations & Growth Manager
jobs.employer_name: BTR Personnel services AB, filial af BTR Personnel services AB, Sverige
jobs.description:
We are looking for an Operations & Growth Manager to join our team and play an important role in the next stage of our growth. We are looking for someone who wants to understand how a growing consumer brand works from the inside and become involved across multiple areas of the business—from operations and retail to marketing, business development, data, systems, and growth.

The Role

As Operations & Growth Manager, you will help manage the day-to-day execution of the business while also working on projects that contribute directly to the company’s growth.

Your responsibilities will span five main areas:

jobs.occupation: Chip Ecosystem Partnership and Funding Manager, The position is a Senior Advisor at TEK Innovation
jobs.description:
Do you want to help facilitate and grow the semiconductor and chip ecosystem in Denmark and beyond, working with the leading researchers in the field, and to turn potential into opportunities, partnerships and projects? Then this job could be for you.  

About the position 

SDU Microelectronics at TEK, headed by professor Farshad Moradi, is part of the Danish Chips Competence Centre (DkCCC) - the new Danish hub for chip technology and your strategic platform. The position offers an opportunity to play a central role in strengthening Denmark’s chip ecosystem and to help connect the ecosystem with fast-growing application areas such as drones, robotics, sensors and autonomous systems, where advanced chip technology is becoming increasingly critical for performance, reliability, energy efficiency and future innovation. 

You will work closely with SDU researchers, DkCCC partners, Danish universities, companies, incubators, industry organizations, funding advisers and European chip networks. Learn more here www.dkccc.eu 

The position involves regular travel within Denmark and occasional travel elsewhere in Europe. 

Your main responsibilities will include:  

• 
Identifying relevant national and European funding opportunities in chip technology, semiconductor development, and chip-enabled applications. 

• 
Developing and maintaining a strategic pipeline of funding calls, project ideas and potential consortium partners. 

• 
Engaging proactively with Danish start-ups, SMEs and established companies to understand their technological needs and funding requirements. 

• 
Connecting companies with relevant researchers, facilities and competencies at SDU and other Danish universities. 

• 
Helping companies and researchers translate technical and business ideas into fundable project concepts. 

• 
Initiating and facilitating Danish and European consortia for chip-related funding calls and identifying opportunities to join existing consortia. 

• 
Promoting Danish chip competencies and contribute to the visibility and strategic development of DkCCC.  

• 
Supporting the full process of funding applications, from project objectives and facilitating consortiums, to coordinating proposals with partners and funding advisers. 

• 
Building relationships with key stakeholders, organizing activities, and events supporting the ecosystem.   

Your profile 
You have a relevant master's degree, for example within engineering or natural sciences, business development or innovation management, economics or business administration, European studies or public policy, research and innovation management, or another relevant field. 

You have documented experience in one or more of the following: 

• 
National or European research and innovation funding 

• 
Development of collaborative funding proposals 

• 
Consortium building and partner identification 

• 
University–industry collaboration or innovation/business development 

• 
Supporting start-ups, SMEs or deep-tech companies 

• 
Stakeholder management and professional networking 

We are looking for a colleague who: 

• 
Is proactive and comfortable initiating contact with companies, researchers and potential partners.  

• 
Is a strong relationship builder who can establish trust across organizational and disciplinary boundaries 

• 
Understands both commercial needs and academic interests and can structure complex consortium-development processes, while maintaining momentum towards a deadline 

• 
Communicates clearly with different stakeholders, technical, academia and experts, business 

• 
Works independently and is persistent and solution oriented, while also contributing actively to a team 

Experience with semiconductors, microelectronics, integrated circuits, quantum technologies, photonics, sensors or other deep-tech fields is a significant advantage — though you don't need to be a chip designer. What matters more is your ability to grasp technology-based opportunities, engage technical specialists, and turn complex ideas into fundable partnerships. Knowledge of European research and innovation programs, including EU Chips Act calls, is also an advantage. 

What we offer 

• 
Become part of SDU’s growing environment for microelectronics and chip technology. 

• 
Build partnerships that may lead to new products, technologies, companies, and investments. 

• 
Work directly with promising Danish start-ups, companies and research environments. 

• 
Help create new university–industry collaborations. 

• 
Develop national and European networks within a strategically important technology area. 

• 
Influence the formation of projects from their earliest stages.  

• 
Collaborate with leading researchers and industry specialists, in an international and interdisciplinary environment. 

• 
A role with considerable independence and the opportunity to shape the methods, networks, and activities used to identify funding opportunities and develop consortia. 

Your organizational home will be TEK Innovation, the research support and innovation unit at TEK, where you will have colleagues with similar jobs, supporting emerging ecosystems, as well as funding advisors and project managers. Your academic home with SDU Microelectronics, where you will work closely with professor Farshad Moradi and his team.  

For further information about the position, please contact: 

Thit Juul Hvid, Head of TEK Innovation, The Technical Faculty at The University of Southern Denmark tjuul@tek.sdu.dk 

Professor Farshad Moradi, SDU Microelectronics, The Technical faculty at The University of Southern Denmark at moradi@sdu.dk  

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support. 

The application deadline is November 1, 2026 at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST).

First Interview: week 46, second interview, week 47.

The startdate will be January 1, 2027, or at the earliest convenience.

Salary and employment terms:  

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary.

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”. 

Employment shall take place in accordance with the framework agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

Application must include cover letter, CV and exam certificate. All documents in connection with the application should not contain CPR number (civil registration number) – in that case, the CPR number must be crossed out.

All documents must be in English and PDF format.  All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected.  

You can only apply for the position at – https://www.sdu.dk/en/om-sdu/job-sdu. 

All attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. Cover letter and CV can contain max. 5 Mb.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

About SDU

The University of Southern Denmark was established to create value for and with society. Whether our contributions come in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education or learning, we must make a positive difference to society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by cultivating talents and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops and recruits talent. At the same time, we need to ensure consistently high quality in all our activities – and we can only do that with the right people. The University’s researchers, lecturers, students, managers and technical/administrative staff are the foundation of our success.

jobs.occupation: Senior Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description:
**Join us to Make an Impact

**Innovation is in our DNA. We invented supercontinuum lasers and photonic crystal fibers and we constantly reimagine how our products can be used and improved. Our customers use our products in medical and life science research, quantum computing and space exploration.

We seek curious, creative and collaborative people to work in our cutting-edge company. Can you see yourself working in teams and providing solutions for innovators?

If you wish to apply, please contact us with your CV / Résumé. If you have a cover letter, please save this in one document with your CV / Résumé as you are only able to upload one document.

We look forward to hearing from you!

**Job Overview

**As a Senior Mechanical Engineer, you will have technical ownership of the mechanical design of laser products and related subsystems. You will work hands-on with the development of robust, opto-mechanical solutions, covering the full lifecycle from early concepts and prototypes to qualification and manufacturing release. The role requires strong technical judgment, practical engineering skills, and the ability to translate requirements into manufacturable designs.

You will be part of the mechanical engineering team in Denmark, working in cross-functional product development projects within a global organization. You will collaborate closely with optical and electronics engineers, suppliers, and manufacturing to ensure technically sound and high-quality solutions.

NKT Photonics offers a supportive working environment with a strong focus on both professional development and work-life balance. We continue to invest in our facilities, tools, and teams to support long-term growth.

**Primary Responsibilities

**

• Take responsibility for mechanical development of laser products throughout the full product lifecycle.

• Collaborate closely with mechanical engineers, optical, and electronics engineers on concept development, prototyping, and design maturation.

• Own defined work packages within product development projects and contribute to planning, execution, and delivery together with project managers.

• Design precision mechanical and opto-mechanical components including creation of 3D models and 2D manufacturing drawings.

• Support prototype assembly, functional testing, and product qualification.

• Support manufacturing of existing laser products, custom orders, and continuous product improvement.

• Ensure product compliance and certification according to relevant standards.

• Contribute to manufacturing release and production ramp-up.

• Work with purchasing and suppliers to identify cost-effective manufacturing solutions for parts and subassemblies, including sourcing and qualifications of new suppliers.

**Your Skills And Experience

**

• A Master of Science in Mechanical Engineering

• 5+ years of experience with pression mechanics or industrial high-tech equipment.

• Strong 3D CAD skills: SolidWorks experience is preferred

• Experience with opto-mechanical systems, components, or laser products is highly advantageous.

• Ability to take ownership and lead mechanical product development.

• Experience working with design for reliability and manufacturability.

• Strong competence in robust design methodologies.

• Solid knowledge of mechanical design and drawing standards for precision CNC machined and sheet metal parts.

• Hands-on practical skills and knowledge of state-of-the-art manufacturing methods.

• Practical experience with 3D printing and basic mechanical workshop tools.

• Knowledge of materials science.

• Experience with PLM/Vault systems and standard Microsoft tools (Excel, Outlook, etc.)

• Expertise with finite element analysis

• Experience with thermal flow simulations.

• Well-developed analytical abilities: able to question complex information, identify root causes, and deliver strong technical solutions.

• Fluent English written and spoken (English is the official company language).

**Keep your personal data safe

**Hamamatsu ("The Company") take responsibly for the protection of your personal data. Accordingly, upon receiving your job application and additional material you choose to submit, the Company keeps a safe and secure environment and ensures confidentiality.

You also have a role to play in keeping your personal data safe. We request you only submit personal data about yourself in your job application, CV / Résumé or other relevant material you choose to provide to us that is relevant for the specific job opening you are applying for.

Please consider whether there is personal information you are about to submit, such as health information, information on family relations, information on trade union membership, etc. that is not necessary for our recruitment process or the job opening you are applying for. Please also be aware that certificates or other documents are not necessary for the vacancy. We urgently request you to redact/cross out such information before you submit your job application.

Thank you.

jobs.occupation: Tax Professional, Customer Handling, Securities Tax Services (Copenhagen)
jobs.description:
**Job Description

**Are you customer-focused, structured and motivated by working in an operational area where quality, documentation and service delivery are key? Do you enjoy supporting customers and advisers, coordinating with internal stakeholders and ensuring that processes run efficiently from start to finish?

We are looking for a detail-oriented colleague to join our Customer Handling Team/Tax Services team in Copenhagen. The team serves as a primary point of contact for advisers and customers and plays an important role in onboarding, documentation management, customer support and service delivery related to securities tax services.

On clients’ behalf, Danske Bank applies for a reduction in foreign tax on returns from securities held in customers’ custody accounts. This includes relief of foreign dividend and interest tax, either at source or through tax reclaim processes. The service is complementary to Danske Bank’s custody service and is particularly relevant for clients earning income on foreign financial instruments, where a tax reduction may be available under applicable double taxation agreements.

**About Securities Tax Services

**Securities Tax Services is part of Danske Bank’s tax area and is responsible for handling services related to withholding tax on securities. The area consists of several teams located in Denmark and Lithuania, working closely together across locations, functions and customer segments.

You will join a team of skilled specialists who support corporate, institutional and other customer segments. We value collaboration, curiosity, continuous learning and a strong focus on delivering high-quality service in a well-controlled environment.

**Your role

**As a team member in Customer Handling, you will support customers and advisers with inquiries, documentation and service-related matters. You will help ensure that customer agreements, onboarding, offboarding and service changes are handled correctly and efficiently.

Your main responsibilities will include:

• Acting as a first point of contact for customer and adviser inquiries

• Handling customer onboarding and offboarding activities

• Ensuring customer agreements and service documentation are sent, received and registered correctly

• Collecting, reviewing and maintaining required customer documentation

• Supporting changes to customer preferences and service setups

• Following up with customers and advisers on outstanding documentation and requests

• Coordinating with internal stakeholders to ensure efficient service delivery

• Participating in client meetings and supporting customer relationship management

• Maintaining and updating information in internal systems

• Supporting controls to ensure accurate and compliant processing

• Contributing to continuous improvement of customer processes and service quality

The role combines recurring operational tasks with customer interaction and collaboration across teams. You will get exposure to securities services, withholding tax processes, custody-related services and post-trade operations.

**About You

**We are looking for a structured and service-minded colleague who enjoys working with customers, documentation and operational processes. You take ownership of tasks, communicate clearly and can manage several activities while maintaining attention to detail.

We imagine that you:

• Have experience from customer service, client support, operations, financial services or a similar area

• Have a customer-centric mindset and strong communication skills

• Are comfortable working with documentation, regulations and operational processes

• Can manage multiple tasks while maintaining high accuracy

• Collaborate well with colleagues and stakeholders across teams and locations

• Are proactive, curious and willing to learn in a complex environment

• Have strong English skills, both written and spoken

Experience from Asset Services, post-trade operations, custody services or withholding tax is considered an advantage.

**What We Offer You

**You will join a supportive team environment where you can develop your expertise through varied work and mentorship opportunities. We operate a hybrid working model with 3 to 4 days per week in the office to promote collaboration and knowledge sharing. Your career will progress through exposure to diverse tax challenges and continuous learning opportunities.

**Are you ready for the next step?

**We would be delighted to hear from you if this opportunity aligns with your career aspirations. Please reach out to our hiring manager Nicolai William Schou Hansen at nicoh@danskebank.dk for any questions about the role. We look forward to hearing from you!

We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

jobs.occupation: Founders Associate (Part-time/Student Assistant)
jobs.description:
**Founders Associate (Part-Time, min. 24 h/week)

Company: Levitate Technology ApS

Location: Copenhagen/Herlev

Start: As soon as possible

****About Us

**Levitate Technology is a fast-growing Danish startup that makes sports and everyday prosthetics for amputees. Our mission is to give amputees better lives through innovative, affordable products. We're growing internationally, and we're looking for a Founders Associate to work closely with our Founder & CEO and keep the company running smoothly.

**The Role

**Your job is to keep things moving. You'll be the link between management, our team, and a wide range of external partners. You will take part in Management meetings, own key business processes and administer the systems the company runs on. You'll also support the CEO on strategic topics that shape where Levitate goes next. The role is broad and varied, with real responsibility from day one.

**What You'll Be Part Of

**

• Company building: helping build the processes and structures that support Levitate's growth.

• Board meetings: helping prepare board materials and following decisions through, with a close view of strategic decision-making.

• Funding and investor relations: supporting funding rounds and investor communication.

**Responsibilities

**

• Stakeholder communication: Be the main point of contact for a wide range of internal and external stakeholders. This includes our external finance team, our bank, our insurance provider, and other partners.

• Strategic projects: Support the CEO on strategic initiatives. This means preparing analyses, following up on company KPIs, and turning information into clear input for management and board decisions.

• Systems administration: Act as admin for our company tools, including Shopify, Google Workspace, Slack, Claude and the rest of our stack. You'll manage users, access and permissions, and keep things organised.

• HR and people operations: Support hiring, payroll, onboarding and offboarding, and day-to-day people operations. You'll work closely with management and external partners.

• Meeting support: Organise and prepare internal and board meetings. This covers agendas, slides, minutes and follow-ups.

• Documentation: Prepare documents, reports and presentations.

• Confidentiality: Handle sensitive company, financial and employee information with discretion.

**Who You Are

**

• Enrolled in a relevant degree with at least one year of studies remaining, preferably a master's programme at Copenhagen Business School.

• Relevant experience from a similar role, a startup, or a management support function.

• Excellent written and spoken English.

• Structured and reliable, with strong attention to detail.

• Analytical, with an interest in strategy and how a company grows.

• Comfortable juggling many topics and stakeholders at once, and able to take ownership without being told every step.

• Confident with digital tools and quick to learn new systems.

**Practical Information

**

• Start date: As soon as possible.

• Hours: minimum of 24 hours per week, flexible around your studies.

• Location: Our office in Herlev, with the option to work from home. You'll be at the office at least 3 days a week.

**What We Offer

**

• A competitive part-time salary.

• Direct collaboration with the Founder & CEO, with insight into strategy, board work and fundraising.

• Real responsibility and a broad view across finance, HR, operations and systems.

• A mission-driven, international team.

• Flexibility to balance work with your studies.

**How To Apply

**Apply through The Hub with your CV and a short motivation statement explaining why this role suits you. We review applications on a rolling basis.

Levitate Technology ApS is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and are committed to an inclusive workplace.

jobs.occupation: Audio Engineer (DSP & Audio Simulation)
jobs.description:
**Job Description

**SOUNDBOKS is an innovative tech company and aspiring lifestyle brand. You may have seen us at a music festival, street party, or your friend’s celebration (think: private events combining festival-grade sound with beat-enhancing lights) where special moments are turned into memories. We create the loudest, most durable, and arguably coolest Bluetooth speakers and audio reactive lights on the market.

At SOUNDBOKS, trust and community go hand in hand. People are encouraged to take ownership of their work while knowing they have the support of the team behind them. Voices are heard, ideas are welcomed, and collaboration is what pushes us forward.

This is more than a job - it’s a community where people care about each other, celebrate together, and share the energy of creating something meaningful. Life at SOUNDBOKS is bold, fast, and full of passion - for the product, for the mission, and for showing up as your true self. With 70 team members, this is a place where you can do your best work and truly belong.

ROLE AUDIO ENGINEER

TEAM PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT

HOURS FULL TIME

LOCATION COPENHAGEN, DENMARK

START DATE OCTOBER 2026 or ASAP

The Product Development team at SOUNDBOKS is the group responsible for the exciting product journey, taking every step of the development process toward and into mass production. In it’s heartbeat you’ll find collaborative and self-driven team members with a large cross-discipline understanding tied to ownership. They are there to make a difference - for the products, the team and the SOUNDBOKS customers as a whole.

As our Audio Engineer, you'll explore new ways to improve the audio experience across SOUNDBOKS products by combining signal processing, system simulation, and engineering insight. Working closely with the Acoustics, Hardware, and Firmware teams, you'll help shape the technologies behind our next generation of speakers.

Okay, let’s make things a little more concrete. Here’s what we expect your daily life to look like:

**Audio System Development

**

• Develop audio concepts and proof-of-concepts at a system level.

• Explore new approaches to improve audio performance across products.

• Collaborate with the Acoustics, Hardware, and Firmware teams during concept development.

**Signal Processing & Simulation

**

• Perform advanced signal processing simulations with a focus on sound pressure level (SPL), sound quality, and system efficiency.

• Simulate the interaction between acoustics, amplifiers, electronics, and battery performance.

• Evaluate and develop signal processing algorithms to improve overall product audio performance.

**System Performance & Collaboration

**

• Work closely across the entire Product Development team in order to evolve and improve the audio performance across our future product portfolio.

• Apply signal processing methodologies to improve sound pressure, sound quality, and battery performance.

**Job Requirements

****In order to become a success in this role, we believe that your profile should be aligned with the bullets listed below. However, we acknowledge that success can take many forms, so please do apply even if you don’t tick all the boxes.

**

• You hold a BSc or higher in Audio Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Acoustics, or a related engineering field.

• You've designed and simulated audio systems, ideally loudspeakers, and know your way around signal processing for audio.

• You're comfortable using simulations and measurements to test ideas, challenge assumptions, and make better engineering decisions.

• It’ll be considered a plus if you have experience working with loudspeaker design, transducers, enclosure design, or audio electronics.

• You get excited by solving difficult audio problems and finding smarter ways to improve performance.

• You're naturally curious, love experimenting, and enjoy digging into the details until things sound and work better.

• You take ownership of your work and enjoy bouncing ideas around with people who know more than you in their field.

• You're drawn to what SOUNDBOKS is building and are excited to be a part of the journey!

Intrigued? At SOUNDBOKS you’ll find yourself a part of a community. We realize that growth is a process and we don’t expect you to go through it alone. Actually, we guarantee that you won’t have to. We work together in order to work smarter, we inspire each other to be better, and we never forget that every member of the team is responsible for our success.

So, if you’re tired of all of the noise in the job market, we’d love to hear from you. This may be the coolest job you ever have.
